logic.note: ILI9341 command set as Adafruit_ILI9341 / Adafruit_GFX use it: SWRESET, SLPIN/SLPOUT, DISPON/DISPOFF, INVON/INVOFF, CASET/PASET windows with wrap, RAMWR/RAMWRC, MADCTL (MY, MX, MV, BGR), COLMOD 16-bit RGB565 and 18-bit RGB666, the 0xD9 register-index reads (RDMODE, RDMADCTL, RDPIXFMT, RDSELFDIAG, RDID4). Power, gamma, frame-rate and display-function parameters are accepted and ignored.

timing.note: Bytes arrive at the speed of the emulated AVR SPI (8 MHz SCK max on an Uno, about 20 CPU cycles per byte with Adafruit's loop), so how long a redraw takes is realistic. The panel itself is instant: no 70 Hz refresh, no tearing, no 5 ms wait after reset or 120 ms after SLPOUT enforced (the library waits anyway).

analog.note: Colours are RGB565 expanded to 8 bits per channel with no gamma curve, so the canvas looks more saturated than a real TN panel, which also washes out at an angle. The backlight is on/off or PWM duty.

power.note: Draws about 20 mA logic plus 60 mA backlight at full brightness from VCC. Losing VCC clears the controller RAM. A 3.3 V-only module reports 5 V logic as an error; electrically nothing breaks in the sim.

emulates: Every drawing call of Adafruit_GFX / Adafruit_ILI9341 (pixels, lines, fillRect fast path, circles, text, bitmaps)
Hardware and software reset, sleep, display on/off, inversion
Backlight on, off and PWM dimming
doesNotEmulate: Panel refresh, tearing and the TE pin
Vertical scrolling (VSCRSADD is stored but the image does not scroll)
Gamma curves and viewing-angle colour shift
Touch controller (XPT2046 / resistive touch) and the SD card slot
testOnRealDevice: Colours: some modules are RGB instead of BGR (red and blue swapped): try tft.invertDisplay() or a different MADCTL
Logic level: bare red modules are 3.3 V logic; on a 5 V Uno use a level shifter (74HC4050) or the module can fail over time
Long SPI wires above 15 cm corrupt pixels at 8 MHz; shorten them or lower the SPI clock
Backlight current (60 to 100 mA) from the Uno 5 V pin together with Wi-Fi and servos
